title: Looking for playtesters to see if this games worth it
author: kkwikmick
selftext:
Im pulling the trigger and putting this online

[https://youtu.be/IPsQPKHSmjc](https://youtu.be/IPsQPKHSmjc)

Hey! Solo dev here (KM Games). Runouts is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game set on British streets.



 Runners hide, sneak and sprint home – chasers hunt them, and anyone caught joins the hunt

Walkie-talkies to talk to your team… but they beep and chasers can hear them

Chasers have a grapple gun to swing around or hook runners

Shout "OH NO!" (or whatever you decide) into your mic to dash away from the chasers

Bribe a chaser to look the other way – nobody has to keep their word

Proximity voice chat for all the panic



I'm looking for playtesters right now – Discord here if you want in: [https://discord.gg/QnkkCqWWK](https://discord.gg/QnkkCqWWK)



Happy to answer any questions or take feedback!
